[[Black Widow]]s are [[Charmable animal|charmable]] arachnids encountered in [[the Underworld]]. It has a distinctive hourglass marking, which is said  to warn her enemies that time's running out. The hourglass organ is used to sense heat sources.

==Notes==
* The Black Widow is one of three ''rare pets'' with their own statues in the [["Fellowship"]] monument in the [[Hall of Monuments]]. The others are the [[Phoenix_(pet)|Phoenix]] and the [[Black Moa Bird]].
* One level 20 Black Widow with a random [[Animal companion#Evolution|evolution]] spawns when completing each of the following quests:
** [[Demon Assassin]]
** [[Imprisoned Spirits]]
** [[Servants of Grenth]]
** [[Terrorweb Queen]]
** [[The Four Horsemen]]
** [[Wrathful Spirits]]
* Three level 20 Black Widows will spawn upon completion of [[The Nightman Cometh]] quest.
* You can hire someone to [[Running#Mission_Running|run]] through The Underworld to help you acquire the pet.
** If you can make the run, bring a hero to capture a spider.
* Black Widows deal [[piercing damage]].
* [[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 5{{zgold}} plus 100{{gold}} or 50,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Prestige, Exotic)''
* Unlike other animals, Black Widow pets are always the same size.
